headline: Oando Returns to Operating Profit in First Nine Months
summary: Oando Plc returned to operating profitability in the nine months ended September 2026, supported by higher crude oil production.
why: Oando Plc is an energy company operating in Nigeria's upstream and downstream petroleum sectors. Operating profitability is a key indicator of financial health for resource companies.

impacts.name: Oando Plc
impacts.why: Higher crude oil production and improved operations drove the return to operating profit.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
